senses.gloss:
डिण्डिक डिण्डिक, अस्, m., N. of a mouse
whose story is told^1 in the Mahā-bh. Udyoga-parva 5440.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.

डिण्डिम डिण्डिम, अस्, m. a musical instru-
ment, a kind of small drum or tabor; a plant bearing
a small fruit, Carissa Carandas.
—डिण्डिमेश्वर-
तीर्थ (˚म-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

डिण्डिर डिण्डिर, अस्, m. cuttle-fish bone
considered to be the foam of the sea; [cf. हिण्डिर
and डिण्डीर.]
—डिण्डिर-मोदक, अम्, n. garlic.

डिण्डीर डिण्डीर, अस्, m. cuttle-fish bone
held to be the foam of the sea; [cf. डिण्डिर.]
डिण्डिश डिण्डिश, अस्, m. = टिण्डिश = तिन्दिश.
